name: Generating video from images or descriptions
gist: Papers on creating video sequences, including techniques to generate motion, extend videos infinitely, combine images, and control the motion that appears on screen.
explain: Video is image generation's harder cousin. A single image can be beautiful and stay still forever, but video requires consistency across dozens or hundreds of frames—the content has to change plausibly over time while maintaining coherence. The car from frame 1 has to still look like the same car in frame 50. The physics has to make sense: if something is falling, it should keep falling. If motion is described ('the camera pans left'), every frame should show the world shifting smoothly leftward. This is radically harder than static images because the model has to learn and enforce temporal consistency.

The challenges break down into several parts. First, generating the initial motion: given a description or a starting image, what should move and how? A model trained on static images doesn't automatically understand motion. Second, extending videos: if you have a 5-second video, can you extend it to 10 seconds by predicting what comes next? Third, interpolating between frames: given frame 1 and frame 10, can you fill in frames 2-9? Fourth, motion control: can you specify exactly how something should move without letting the model decide? And fifth, infinite extension: can you keep generating new frames indefinitely while keeping the content coherent?

Papers here use several approaches. Some train separate models specifically for motion by using video data as training signal—showing the model pairs of consecutive frames so it learns what realistic motion looks like (a car doesn't teleport, it drives smoothly). Others use optical flow (the direction and speed pixels move between frames) as an intermediate representation—the model predicts flow first, then uses flow to warp or generate pixels, which breaks the problem into steps that are easier to solve. Some papers combine static image generation with a separate 'motion module' that predicts how each part should move, which lets them reuse existing image technology. For control, researchers use techniques borrowed from text-to-image work: if you can condition generation on text descriptions, you can condition it on motion descriptions, so users can specify 'pan left' or 'zoom in.' For infinite video, the trick is usually to process frames in overlapping windows so the model always has context about what came before, which lets it generate the next frame aware of earlier context and thus maintain coherence.

papers.title: LVTINO: LAtent Video consisTency INverse sOlver for High Definition Video Restoration
papers.contribution: First zero-shot plug-and-play inverse solver for high-definition video restoration; achieves state-of-the-art quality with few evaluations while ensuring temporal smoothness.

papers.title: MAGREF: Masked Guidance for Any-Reference Video Generation with Subject Disentanglement
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on comprehensive benchmarks, enabling scalable and controllable high-fidelity any-reference video synthesis.

papers.title: MicroVerse: A Preliminary Exploration Toward a Micro-World Simulation
papers.contribution: Introduces the Micro-World Simulation concept with MicroVerse achieving accurate reproduction of complex microscale phenomena for biomedical and educational applications.

papers.title: MoCa: Modeling Object Consistency for 3D Camera Control in Video Generation
papers.contribution: MoCa achieves accurate camera control in video generation while maintaining view, appearance, and motion consistency across frames without explicit 3D supervision.

papers.title: MoGA: Mixture-of-Groups Attention for End-to-End Long Video Generation
papers.contribution: An efficient long video generation model produces minute-level, multi-shot 480p videos at 24 fps with a context length of approximately 580k tokens.

papers.title: Model Already Knows the Best Noise: Bayesian Active Noise Selection via Attention in Video Diffusion Model
papers.contribution: Improves video quality and temporal coherence with marginal inference overhead across diverse text-to-video backbones.

papers.title: Motion Prior Distillation in Time Reversal Sampling for Generative Inbetweening
papers.contribution: Yields more temporally coherent inbetweening results with forward motion prior, validated through quantitative evaluation and extensive user studies on practical scenarios.

papers.title: Phantom-Data: Towards a General Subject-Consistent Video Generation Dataset
papers.contribution: Training with Phantom-Data significantly improves prompt alignment and visual quality while preserving identity consistency on par with in-pair baselines.

papers.title: Rolling Forcing: Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion in Real Time
papers.contribution: Rolling Forcing enables real-time streaming generation of multi-minute videos on a single GPU with substantially reduced error accumulation.

papers.title: SteinsGate: Adding Causality to Diffusions for Long Video Generation via Path Integral
papers.contribution: Generates natural, smooth multi-action long videos with accurate temporal control; converts pre-trained diffusion models into autoregressive continuation models.

papers.title: Towards One-step Causal Video Generation via Adversarial Self-Distillation
papers.contribution: Surpasses state-of-the-art on one-step and two-step video generation, supporting flexible multiple inference-step settings with a single model.

papers.title: 3D Scene Prompting for Scene-Consistent Camera-Controllable Video Generation
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms existing methods in scene consistency, camera controllability, and generation quality through geometrically-consistent scene memory projections.

papers.title: AAD-1: Asymmetric Adversarial Distillation for One-Step Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.contribution: AAD-1 achieves state-of-the-art performance in one-step autoregressive video generation on VBench, addressing motion collapse through global temporal failure detection.

papers.title: AlignSep: Temporally-Aligned Video-Queried Sound Separation with Flow Matching
papers.contribution: Achieves SOTA on multiple benchmarks; introduces VGGSound-Hard benchmark; demonstrates practical value for real-world separation in complex scenes.

papers.title: AlignVid: Taming Visual Dominance via Training-Free Attention Modulation in Text-guided Image-to-Video Generation
papers.contribution: Effectively enhances semantic fidelity with negligible computational overhead across object addition, deletion, and modification benchmarks.

papers.title: Bridging Your Imagination with Audio-Video Generation via a Unified Director
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models generating logically coherent scripts and visually consistent keyframes.

papers.title: CamGeo: Sparse Camera-Conditioned Image-to-Video Generation with 3D Geometry Priors
papers.contribution: To achieve this without incurring inference latency, we propose a training-only distillation strategy

papers.title: CameraNoise: Enabling Faithful Camera Control in Video Diffusion through Geometry-Flow-Guided Noise Warping
papers.contribution: Delivers stable, high-fidelity videos with faithful camera trajectory control by embedding poses directly into noise rather than conditioning on parameters.

papers.title: Captain Cinema: Towards Short Movie Generation
papers.contribution: Captain Cinema demonstrates favorable performance in automated creation of visually coherent and narratively consistent short films.

papers.title: Causal Forcing: Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation Done Right for High-Quality Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
papers.contribution: Causal Forcing outperforms Self Forcing by 19.3% in Dynamic Degree, 8.7% in VisionReward, and 16.7% in Instruction Following for real-time interactive video generation.

papers.title: Comp-Attn: Present-and-Align Attention for Compositional Video Generation
papers.contribution: Boosts T2V-CompBench scores by 15.7% and 11.7% on two baselines with only 5% inference overhead, scaling to general T2V and compositional T2I.

papers.title: ConsisDrive: Identity-Preserving Driving World Models for Video Generation by Instance Mask

papers.title: Context Forcing: Consistent Autoregressive Video Generation with Long Context
papers.contribution: Enables effective context lengths exceeding 20 seconds, 6-10× longer than state-of-the-art methods like LongLive and Infinite-RoPE, preserving superior consistency across long durations.

papers.title: Controllable First-Frame-Guided Video Editing via Mask-Aware LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.contribution: Enables users to control the entire temporal evolution of complex edits like object rotation or flower blooming, outperforming baseline methods in video editing performance.

papers.title: Controllable Video Generation with Provable Disentanglement
papers.contribution: Provides theoretical guarantees demonstrating identifiability and significantly improves generation quality and controllability through a Temporal Transition Module for independent control over motion and identity.

papers.title: DiasR: Dual-Modal Identity-Anchored Sparse Routing for Efficient Multi-Subject Video Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance in identity consistency, text fidelity, and naturalness; maintains nearly constant inference time as subject count increases; released MuSA-2M dataset of 2 million annotated samples.

papers.title: DreamSwapV: Mask-guided Subject Swapping for Any Customized Video Editing
papers.contribution: DreamSwapV outperforms existing methods on VBench indicators and introduces the first DreamSwapV-Benchmark for video subject swapping.

papers.title: Durian: Dual Reference Image-Guided Portrait Animation with Attribute Transfer
papers.contribution: Durian enables portrait animation with attribute transfer, supports multi-attribute composition and smooth interpolation within single generation.

papers.title: DynaMem: Consistent Long Video Generation via Hierarchical Memory and Motion Priors
papers.contribution: Produces more consistent semantics, stronger temporal dynamics, and more stable appearance on long videos compared to competitive baselines.

papers.title: EditVerse: Unifying Image and Video Editing and Generation with In-Context Learning
papers.contribution: State-of-the-art performance across image/video generation and editing, surpassing open-source and commercial models with emergent cross-modal abilities.

papers.title: EgoTwin: Dreaming Body and View in First Person
papers.contribution: EgoTwin demonstrates effective joint video-motion generation with newly curated synchronized text-video-motion dataset and novel consistency metrics.

papers.title: Enhancing Train-Free Infinite-Frame Generation for Consistent Long Videos
papers.contribution: MIGA achieves state-of-the-art performance on VBench and NarrLV with improved temporal consistency in infinite-frame generation.

papers.title: Evaluating Intuitive Physics Understanding in Video Diffusion Models via Likelihood Preference
papers.contribution: LikePhys demonstrates strong alignment with human preference for physics plausibility, outperforming state-of-the-art evaluators and revealing domain-specific capacity variations across physics domains.

papers.title: FantasyWorld: Geometry-Consistent World Modeling via Unified Video and 3D Prediction

papers.title: Flash-VAED: Plug-and-Play VAE Decoders for Efficient Video Generation

papers.title: Flex-Forcing: Towards a Unified Autoregressive and Bidirectional Video Diffusion Model
papers.contribution: Achieves consistently better video quality and long-video stability than baselines with rigid schedules while offering faster inference.

papers.title: Flow Caching for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.contribution: The method achieves 2.38× speedup on MAGI-1 and 6.7× speedup on SkyReels-V2 with negligible quality degradation.

papers.title: FreeViS: Training-free Video Stylization with Inconsistent References
papers.contribution: Delivers higher stylization fidelity and superior temporal consistency without training, outperforming recent baselines in human preference studies.

papers.title: FunPhase: A Periodic Functional Autoencoder for Motion Generation via Phase Manifolds
papers.contribution: Achieves at least 45% lower reconstruction error than prior periodic autoencoder baselines, unifies motion prediction and generation, and generalizes across skeletons and datasets.

papers.title: Generative View Stitching

papers.title: Geometry Forcing: Marrying Video Diffusion and 3D Representation for Consistent World Modeling

papers.title: HECTOR: Hybrid Editable Compositional Object References for Video Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves superior visual quality, stronger reference preservation, and improved motion controllability.

papers.title: In-Context Generation with Regional Constraints for Instructional Video Editing
papers.contribution: Superior performance across four instruction-based video editing tasks with a large-scale ReCo-Data dataset of 500K instruction-video pairs.

papers.title: LUVE : Latent-Cascaded Ultra-High-Resolution Video Generation with Dual Frequency Experts
papers.contribution: Achieves superior photorealism and content fidelity in UHR video generation.

papers.title: LayerT2V: A Unified Multi-Layer Video Generation Framework
papers.contribution: Substantially outperforms prior methods in visual fidelity, temporal consistency, and cross-layer coherence; introduces VidLayer, the first large-scale dataset for multi-layer video generation.

papers.title: Light-X: Generative 4D Video Rendering with Camera and Illumination Control
papers.contribution: Outperforms baseline methods in joint camera-illumination control; surpasses prior video relighting in text and background-conditioned settings.

papers.title: LongLive: Real-time Interactive Long Video Generation
papers.contribution: Fine-tunes a 1.3B model for minute-long generation in 32 GPU-days and sustains 20.7 FPS on a single H100, achieving strong performance on VBench for both short and long videos.

papers.title: MATRIX: Mask Track Alignment for Interaction-aware Video Generation
papers.contribution: Improves interaction fidelity and semantic alignment while reducing drift and hallucination in interaction-aware video generation.

papers.title: MIMIC: Mask-Injected Manipulation Video Generation with Interaction Control
papers.contribution: MIMIC significantly outperforms existing methods, effectively preserving manipulation intent and motion details for diverse and deformable objects.

papers.title: MTVCraft: Tokenizing 4D Motion for Arbitrary Character Animation
papers.contribution: MTVCraft achieves state-of-the-art performance on TikTok and Fashion benchmarks and demonstrates unprecedented zero-shot generalization to arbitrary characters.

papers.title: MVCustom: Multi-View Customized Diffusion via Geometric Latent Rendering and Completion
papers.contribution: MVCustom achieves balanced performance across multi-view consistency and customization fidelity with effective solution to the unification problem.

papers.title: Mixture of Contexts for Long Video Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves near-linear scaling efficiency by allocating compute to salient history, preserving identities, actions, and scenes over minutes of content without loop closures.

papers.title: MoSA: Motion-Coherent Human Video Generation via Structure-Appearance Decoupling
papers.contribution: Substantially outperforms existing approaches across evaluation metrics and contributes a large-scale human video dataset with more complex and diverse motions than prior datasets.

papers.title: MotiMotion: Motion-Controlled Video Generation with Visual Reasoning
papers.contribution: Produces videos with more plausible object behaviors and interactions, curates MotiBench benchmark for interaction-centric scenes, outperforms existing approaches in VLM-based and human evaluation.

papers.contribution: With Motive-selected high-influence data, temporal consistency and physical plausibility improve on VBench, achieving 74.1% human preference win rate versus the pretrained base model.

papers.title: NewtonGen: Physics-consistent and Controllable Text-to-Video Generation via Neural Newtonian Dynamics
papers.contribution: Moreover, these models lack precise parameter control, struggling to generate physically consistent dynamics under different initial conditions.

papers.title: Streaming Autoregressive Video Generation via Diagonal Distillation

papers.title: TS-Attn: Temporal-wise Separable Attention for Multi-Event Video Generation
papers.contribution: Boosts StoryEval-Bench scores by 33.5% and 16.4% on Wan2.1 and Wan2.2 models with only 2% inference time increase.

papers.title: TTOM: Test-Time Optimization and Memorization for Compositional Video Generation
papers.contribution: TTOM disentangles compositional world knowledge with strong transferability, establishing effective cross-modal alignment for compositional video generation.
